material_review_findings_addressed: Non-ENOENT/ESRCH malformed, cap, deadline, identity and churn errors stay sticky even if the original pidfd becomes terminal.
Only missing-proc errors with an available terminal original pidfd can be classified as departed; missing pidfd and other unreadable metadata remain HOLD.
PID/TID before tuples are retained and final live birth mismatches/new/unobserved PIDs are HOLD, not numeric membership-only acceptance.
Thread fd target sets and cwd/root/exe targets are reread in addition to fd numbers and namespaces/birth; pid_for_children is checked.
Finite build-name matcher enlarged and explicitly not standalone no-build evidence.
SLOT uses fstat against pre/path pins, duplicate/nonfinite JSON rejection, and final identical image; required memory rows are unique.
Self is not excluded solely by a source assertion: fixed W cwd, one thread, namespace links and inherited fd links receive explicit checks.
Visible parent bind-alias coverage derives filesystem-relative R from the unique containing mount rather than testing only literal absolute R roots.
Issue lists are aggregate-bounded to64 and any overflow is HOLD; late cooperative expiry cannot yield successful completion merely because resource syscalls returned.
method: Exact source text review only. Final stable no-follow file read plus complete matching second read; no source parsing/import/execution or proc/runtime/tool probe. Earlier GUI03 actual result was not rerun or re-reviewed.
minimum_honest_root_admission: Retain exact accepted observer source and promoted image, fixed invocation, and complete authoritative tool result. Require exit0, no live session, CLEAR-not-cleanup status, empty conflicts/references/unclassified and no truncation before using negative observations.
Bind actual output parent namespaces, original R/lock tuples, idle-slot digest, resources and monotonic stamp into the separate admission packet; preserve source/actual review bindings.

The closer schema accepts only complete exit0 packets with nonempty outputs <=65536 bytes and no session_id, <=32 packets, and an observation stamp within900s at its coordination checks; a nonempty object is not itself proof.

Root must independently and honestly attest maintained cooperative original-R writer freeze since GUI03 terminal, sole-root closeout ownership, all-tool/agent quiescence and no concurrent build/test/CI; preserve that freeze between the point observation and closer settlement.

Interpret reference/alias-absence flags only within the explicitly reviewed visible metadata/parent-mount coverage plus maintained cooperative assumptions, never as arbitrary/global/continuous/hostile absence. If those conditions cannot be honestly attested, leave UNBOUND/HOLD.

Exact independent closer reviewer must assess actual packet completeness and scope. This observer source acceptance is not their approval, an actual absence result, fresh source-after proof, or permission to access/delete R.

An unknown, conflict, original-domain/runtime reference, stale observation, incomplete tool result, image drift or lost writer freeze prevents admission; no automatic replay, stop, cleanup or reinterpretation as success.
read_only_observer_scope: Fixed isolated root Python entry, explicit original parent mnt/pid/net tuple, single-reader-thread/exact-W-cwd/self namespace and inherited descriptor-link context.
Original named R root, R parent and lock-parent metadata only: no R traversal, source/transport/generated-file read, deletion or namespace entry.
Named SLOT regular-file bounded bytes and stable pre/open/post/path pins; strict JSON idle state and unchanged final image.
Original named lock descriptor/path pins and one nonblocking exclusive flock, released on exit; no lock or slot contents written.
Visible /proc PID/thread birth and namespace/pid_for_children/cwd/root/exe/fd-link metadata; per-process maps metadata, not referenced-file contents.
Original PID pidfd observations only, no signal, adoption, child creation or numeric-PID fallback; PID/TID final birth reconciliation and bounded after-only detection.
Current parent mountinfo decoded root/point inventory and same-device/fstype containing-mount-relative alias checks, unchanged before/after digest.
Current parent filesystem capacity and bounded MemTotal/MemAvailable metadata, resource floors, 90s cooperative deadline checked after final main/lock close.

schema_context_as_read.qualification: Read admission/coordination interface only as context, not independent acceptance of the closer, a current promoted closer image, or any root admission.

unavoidable_scope_limitations: Non-atomic finite sweeps/rereads are bounded point observations, not one simultaneous snapshot, continuous idleness or a promise about later PID/fd reuse.
Finite process-leader comm matching cannot classify every compiler/interpreter or establish all no-build/no-CI facts.
Alias checks cover visible parent mounts with matching filesystem identity/type. Other namespaces, hidden/arbitrary aliases and ancestor-path capabilities are not excluded.
Namespace-number equality is a matching/refusal observation, not inherited ownership or signalling/deletion authority.
Terminal departures are classified from original pidfds; their unobserved metadata are not represented as complete live scans.

Read-only means no persistent file-content mutation; nonblocking flock and descriptor opens/closes still change temporary kernel state. Lock availability is a point, not sustained exclusivity after observer exit.
Cooperative elapsed-time guards cannot bound blocked kernel syscalls or hostile-root interference. Actual external exit is authoritative.
